reason: The analyst's 'no effect' rests on a single specification run only in the north region, which is an unjustified subgroup choice. In the full sample with pre-period controls the effect is +0.84 (SE 0.24, p<0.001), matching my own analysis, and the north-only estimate is just the weakest of the three regions (south is 1.86). The report also understates specification search by listing one specification, and it omits other pre-period controls.
